touch_1.money_voice_fit: Strong. Leads money+status ('biggest job handed to whoever was in the room first, not you'), real $ proof inventory ($730M/$120M/$84M) beneath the hook, deliverable CTA. Mechanism is implied, not led.

touch_2.money_voice_fit: Strong. Identity/ambition jolt ('didn't build a real shop to fight 8 bidders'), enemy = public bid board race-to-bottom. 'Earlier, not better bidders' reframe.

touch_3.money_voice_fit: Strong. Proof-led touch — full verified inventory does the work, broadened across medical/warehouse/data center/civic. Named $ anchors carry credibility.

touch_4.money_voice_fit: Strong. Explicit down-market disqualifier ('$10M+, not one-crew subs') + bold pay-on-results guarantee at the close ('don't pay until you sign one, we carry the risk'). Guarantee held to Touch 4 per rule.
